title: PFCP: Add dissector support for Juniper L2TP IEs 32938, 32941
description:
Added dissection for PFCP_JNPR_L2TP_IE (32941) and its nested
PFCP_JNPR_REMOTE_L2TP_TUNNEL_ENDPOINT_IE (32938), used in Session Modify
Requests (CP->UP).

IE 32941 is a grouped IE containing both Juniper and BBF tunnel
endpoint fields. The nested IE 32938 extracts L2TP tunnel metadata such
as tunnel ID, ports, flags, IPv4 address, and tunnel index.
